content: Modern real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) devices have significantly reduced the need for frequent manual calibration, which was a notable challenge in earlier systems. This improvement enhances user convenience and simplifies the overall process of glucose monitoring. Some advanced rtCGM systems are equipped with auto-calibration features, eliminating the need for manual input. Additionally, these systems can integrate seamlessly with insulin pumps, enabling automated insulin delivery based on real-time glucose readings. This integration allows for more precise and responsive diabetes management. These advancements have proven to be highly beneficial for both adults and children living with diabetes. By reducing the reliance on manual blood glucose testing, these systems alleviate the associated burden and provide a more dynamic and efficient approach to managing blood glucose levels.
